name: Laurie Scanlon
tribute: Laurie, the co-owner of NEGX and GET, had been bravely battling cancer for approximately 10 years. Most of us will remember Laurie as the Master of Ceremonies at our Level 7 & 8 State Championships for several years, and just recently at our Level 7-10 State Championships in Newtown. Always focused on the gymnasts, Laurie never brought attention to herself or to her battle. We have lost a champion for kids.
